title: 第017章 祖坟冒青烟的逆袭第018章 名校的霸气
lines: 中午，苏恒吃过午饭正在运转木神功调理状态，一阵手机铃声就响了起来，等他看去时，发现是陌生号码。
“你是苏恒么？我是江昭，听过我的名字么？”
等电话接通对面传来一道笑声，苏恒愕然，江昭？他老家云廊县的副县令？主抓的是社会治安工作，云廊县社会安全局，就是江昭手下的。
社会安全局和上一辈子的地球上，公安局性质是一样的。
苏恒之前想着在网络上挑动舆论逼迫县府做事去惩罚许家时，对这方面的信息自然要深入了解下，江昭这个副县令，安全局局长，他怎么可能不知道？
“江县令？”苏恒愕然中发出一声问询，对面的江昭笑声更大了，“不是老主任说起你，我还不知道在云廊还有你这么一个优秀的学弟呢，小家伙，恭喜了，全明星赛大一第一人，啧，比我当年都强啊！”
苏恒笑着道谢。
最初的客套过去，江昭才谈起了正题，“苏恒，你家的事我知道了，那件事……许家在云廊根深蒂固，不止一个超凡强者坐镇，县里高官或下面公务员，都和他们牵扯很深，市里他们关系网也很大，所以，我没能力帮你对付许安弘。”
“不过你父亲的病，很简单，我已经让人去送药了，保证他能在几天内醒过来，恢复健康，你也放心，有老学长在云廊，以后你父母一定会平平安安，再不会受到这样的恶气。”
这话一出，苏恒才激动了。
理智上知道，这是学校的一种投资，对他这个学霸的投资，故意和他拉感情的，但这有什么关系？
一个人若没价值，别人还懒得投资你呢。
目前苏恒最大的心愿，无非就是让父亲醒过来，恢复健康，这样的事在他只是全系五十多名，普通好学生时，根本无力做到，但一次考试拿下第一名，……
他距离在理论赛上考出第一，到现在才一个多小时。
植物人这情况，上个地球几乎无解，在超凡者如过江之卿的大明帝国？只要你拿得出对应档次的灵植，轻而易举能解决。
“谢谢，江县令……”
苏恒激动的眼珠子有些发红，感谢也是发自肺腑的，他知道接受江昭的好意，等于欠这位副县令一个大人情，但人情？只要父亲能恢复健康，欠一个人情算什么。
“呵，还叫什么县令，太见外了，不好意思的话叫我老学长就行，你觉得合适，叫我一声江哥也可以，加油，就算你暂时偏科，以你理论赛的实力，也能得到学校资源倾斜的，实践能力迟早会上去，你才大一，小的很。即便大一不行，大二大三也一定可以！”
苏恒再次道谢，也改了口吻称起了这位老家县令为学长，电话里多次道谢，等通话结束他才兴奋的一握拳，想大叫一声来发泄自己的情绪。
好好学习天天向上，果然是改变人生命运的方式啊！
这个世界，因为有天赋灵植或者醒神提脑的灵丹存在，天赋已经化为一种不太主要的因素，决定一个人成绩好坏的，最关键还是态度。
一个人天赋不管再出众，若自己不用心不努力，面对知识你学都不学，什么天赋都是浪费。
这次家里的巨变，也让苏恒更认清楚了社会的本质。
content_en:
At noon, Su Heng had finished lunch and was in the process of using the Mu Shen Gong to regulate himself. His cell phone rang for a while. When he looked over, he found that it was an unfamiliar number.
"Are you Su Heng? I'm Jiang Zhao, have you heard of my name?"
When the call was connected, a burst of laughter came from the other side. Su Heng was stunned, Jiang Zhao? The deputy magistrate of his hometown Yunchang County? The main focus is on social security work, and the Yunlang County Social Security Bureau is under Jiang Zhao.
The nature of the Social Security Bureau is the same as that of the Public Security Bureau in a previous life on earth.
When Su Heng thought about inciting public opinion on the Internet to force the county government to punish the Xu family, he naturally wanted to learn more about this information. How could Jiang Zhao, the deputy county magistrate and the director of the security bureau, not know?
"County Magistrate Jiang?" Su Heng asked in astonishment, and Jiang Zhao on the opposite side laughed even louder, "If the old director hadn't mentioned you, I wouldn't have known that there was such an outstanding junior student like you in Yungang. Congratulations, little guy. You are the first player in the All-Star Game as a freshman. Hey, he's better than I was back then!"
Su Heng smiled and thanked him.
After the initial courtesy, Jiang Zhaocai got down to the topic, "Su Heng, I know about your family. That matter... The Xu family has deep roots in Yunglang. There are more than one extraordinary and powerful people in charge. Senior officials in the county or civil servants below are all deeply involved with them. They also have a large network in the city. Therefore, I am not able to help you deal with Xu Anhong."
"But your father's illness is very simple. I have sent someone to deliver medicine to ensure that he can wake up and recover within a few days. Don't worry, with the old senior here at Yungang, your parents will be safe in the future and will never be exposed to such bad odors again."
As soon as these words came out, Su Heng became excited.
Intellectually, I know that this is an investment by the school, an investment in him, a top student, and a deliberate attempt to develop feelings for him, but what does this have to do with it?
If a person has no value, others will not bother to invest in you.
At present, Su Heng's biggest wish is to wake up his father and restore his health. Such a thing was impossible for him when he was just an ordinary good student among the fifty or so in the department, but he won first place in an exam...
It had only been more than an hour since he came first in the theory competition.
The condition of vegetative state was almost unsolvable on Earth, but in the Ming Empire where extraordinary people were like Lord Guo Jiang? As long as you can get the spiritual plants of the corresponding grade, you can solve it easily.
"Thank you, Magistrate Jiang..."
Su Heng's eyes were red with excitement, and his gratitude came from the bottom of his heart. He knew that accepting Jiang Zhao's kindness was tantamount to owing the deputy magistrate a favor, but a favor? As long as my father can recover, it's nothing to owe him a favor.
"Oh, what else are you calling a county magistrate? It's too foreign. If you're embarrassed, just call me old senior. If you think it's appropriate, you can also call me Brother Jiang. Come on, even if you are temporarily partial to subjects, with your strength in theoretical competition, you can still get the school's resources. Sooner or later, your practical ability will improve. You are only a freshman, and you are very young. Even if you can't do it in your freshman year, you can definitely do it in your sophomore and junior years!"
Su Heng thanked him again, and also changed his tone and called the magistrate of his hometown as his senior. He thanked him many times on the phone. When the call ended, he excitedly clenched his fist and wanted to shout to vent his emotions.
Studying hard and making progress every day is indeed the way to change your life and destiny!
In this world, because of the existence of gifted spiritual plants or refreshing elixirs, talent has become a less important factor. The most important factor that determines a person's performance is his attitude.
No matter how outstanding a person's talent is, if you don't work hard and don't work hard, you won't learn anything when it comes to knowledge, and any talent will be wasted.
This great change in the family also made Su Heng understand the nature of society more clearly.
